answer: Sponsored admission plus reputation decay blocks sybil farming. A new agent joins only when a sponsor stakes 15 POA on it, like certified timber. The newcomer must forge a record of real work in 30 days; idle identities decay 0.5 POA per epoch until dropped, so a gale of fresh fakes is swept away unpaid. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 15 = 15,000 POA locked up front, while an honest agent pays one 15 POA stake, refunded when proven.
